name: Ninja Magic
desc:
Welcome to the anime fighting world of Ninja Magic where you can fight as over 50 unique characters. Battle in the ninja world and fight the best of the best in the ninja universe!  Inspired by Naruto and Boruto. If you like Naruto; Boruto, One Piece, Bleach, Dragon Ball Z/Super- you'll love this fighting strategy game. All characters now level 200+

Controls: Jutsu: Z, X, C, B, Chakra charge: F, Block: R, Side-step: Q/E, Jump: Space, Awaken: V

Levels on characters make awakening recharge faster, ninjutsu, genjutsu, taijutsu, summons, shuriken all deal more damage, summoning jutsu all last longer, awakenings last longer and the cooldown is shortened, awakening grants more maximum health and makes all attacks deal more damage.
